  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2" ns2:attr="value">
  <!-- This is a top-level comment describing the root element -->
  <child ns2:id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA content with <tags> and &internal; references.
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
